name: mobile-test-bench
description: Mirror and control Android and iOS devices in VS Code, inspect their UI, and get ready-to-use Mobilewright, Appium and WebdriverIO locators.

mobileTestBench.adbPath.markdownDescription: Path to `adb`. Empty: look in `ANDROID_HOME`, the default SDK folder and `PATH`.

mobileTestBench.useEmulatorGrpc.description: Use the emulator gRPC connection for fast frames and input on Android emulators.

mobileTestBench.screenshotIntervalMs.description: Interval of the screenshot fallback, in milliseconds.

mobileTestBench.wdaUrl.description: WebDriverAgent URL, for iOS simulators when mobilecli is not installed.

mobileTestBench.longPressMs.description: How long the mouse stays down before it counts as a long press, in milliseconds.

mobileTestBench.elementFilter.description: Last filter text of the element inspector.

mobileTestBench.locatorLanguage.description: Language of the Copy as action of the Locators tab.

mobileTestBench.contrastHints.description: Add colour contrast hints to the accessibility audit.

mobileTestBench.replayTimeoutSeconds.description: Default wait timeout of a replay step, in seconds.

mobileTestBench.replayDelayMs.description: Pause between replay steps, in milliseconds.

mobileTestBench.hideSystemApps.description: Hide system apps in the Apps tab.

mobileTestBench.reconnectAutomatically.description: Reconnect automatically when a device drops.

mobileTestBench.reconnectToLastDevice.description: Reconnect to the last used device when the workspace opens.

mobileTestBench.showGrid.description: Draw a coordinate grid over the mirror.

mobileTestBench.visualTolerance.description: Colour tolerance of the visual diff.

mobileTestBench.perfWindowSeconds.description: Window of the performance charts, in seconds.
